task.title: Set Up a Print Server
task.shortdesc: Follow these steps to set up a print server with SNMP enabled.

prereq.p: Ensure you have administrative rights, network connectivity, and SNMP enabled.

step.cmd: Log in to the server with administrative credentials.
Open the Server Manager and select 'Add roles and features'.
Choose 'Print and Document Services' and click 'Next'.
Enable SNMP by selecting the 'SNMP Service' checkbox.
Complete the installation and restart the server if prompted.
Verify the print server setup by printing a test page.

note.p: If you encounter issues with SNMP or bi-directionality, refer to the SNMP Troubleshooting and Bi-directionality Troubleshooting topics.
